recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future template work removes the master-definition links from abstract or interface resource pages.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-BaseResource clarification asking for Resource and likely other abstract resources to have the same hyperlinks to StructureDefinition files as concrete resources such as Patient.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit 5d5c91aa453bd631d2bc8d6dc4845e7a262a4911 applied FHIR-37810 on 2022-08-09 by adding master-definition hyperlinks to the abstract resource template and cleaning the normal resource template link text. Later template refactors preserved the current master-definition links.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Resource and DomainResource as abstract infrastructure resources and CanonicalResource and MetadataResource as interface infrastructure resources. Their StructureDefinition XML sources exist, and the current abstract/interface templates expose master-definition XML/JSON links. FHIR-I minutes record the 2022-07-25 Persuasive 10-0-0 motion, and no conflicting community or related Jira evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the issue and duplicate prose or links would not change implementer understanding.
